summary: Frontend-only regression for iteration_4 at 390x844. Primary research-accessibility bug is FIXED and all new AI-generated stylized-3D art assets render across screens with zero non-deprecation console errors. (1) RESEARCH BUG — Fresh account lord.tester@idle1.app: login OK; no tutorial (already dismissed on this account this run); tab-kingdom -> kingdom-screen visible; the 'Ricerca' Btn with testID open-research-button sits directly under the KingdomScene at y=413.5 (bbox {x:12,y:413.5,w:179,h:48}) — fully visible in the 390x844 viewport WITHOUT scrolling; kingdom-scene contains 17 elements (ground + building art). Tapping building-university opens building-sheet (Universita, Lv 2/20) which contains the new 'Apri Ricerca' button (testID sheet-open-research-button) — pressing it navigates to /kingdom/research. On research-screen the branch chip testID branch-economy is present, node testID node-economy.crop_yield renders with an ENABLED research-start-economy.crop_yield button (aria-disabled=null). Pressing 'Avvia' triggers the toast 'Ricerca avviata' and the active-research panel appears: 'In corso: economy.crop_yield -> livello 1, 9m 57s'. The 'Rendita Agricola' node itself switches to 'In corso' state. (No research-reason-* chip is shown on the fresh account because at castle 2 crop_yield is the only unlocked economy node — the other economy nodes are locked with 'Richiede Castello 4/7/10' and their Avvia button is correctly disabled; reason chips only render when a node is unlocked & not in queue & (busy || can't afford).) (2) RESEARCH BUG — QA account qa.lord@example.com (castle 9): tab-kingdom -> tap building-university -> building-sheet shows sheet-open-research-button (bbox {x:16,y:627,w:358,h:48}) as expected. Screenshot confirms the university sheet renders the Apri Ricerca CTA in gold plus 'Prossimo livello 3' upgrade panel. (3) GRAPHICS overhaul verified — Battle tab (QA): battle-scene visible with 22 descendant s; lord-sprite > lord-art > present; monster-horde contains 8 s inside monster-art wrappers; formation-proxies has 12 unit s (QA infantry); hero-card > hero-portrait > present. Screenshot shows the Stage 25 Blackwood elite scene: painted forest region background, armored Lord holding sword with LORD banner, three brute monsters, background cohort, damage number '862'. Kingdom tab (QA): kingdom-scene has 17 s; ground.webp full-bleed background + castle/farm/lumberyard/university/etc. rendered as stylized-3D building sprites with 'Borgo di Frontiera Castello 9 · Tier 3' HUD. Army tab: 47 s (unit portraits/cards). Login screen: is rendered by HeroBackdrop behind the login form. Alliance Titan Hunt (Social -> hub-boss tile navigates to /alliance/boss): boss screen shows 25 s including region_2.webp background and the boss sprite (large orc-like Titan on HP bar). (4) SKILL VFX regression: skill-banner testID observed while on battle-scene for the QA account within 10s (power_strike auto-fires every 9s). (5) Console: 0 non-deprecation error-level messages during the full test run (only known web deprecation warnings for pointerEvents/textShadow/shadow*/tintColor were emitted). (6) Expo Go acceptance: `node scripts/expo-go-acceptance.mjs` -> PASS (static scan + android/ios metro bundle graph checks all green).
action_items: No new fixes required. Research accessibility bug is fully addressed by the new open-research-button under the KingdomScene AND the sheet-open-research-button in the university building sheet — both discoverable without scrolling.
Pre-existing (from iteration_1) not in scope this iteration: talents NaN% at src/hero/talents.tsx:43 remains open.
critical_code_review_comments: app/(tabs)/kingdom.tsx:37-40 places the Ricerca/Esercito Btn row immediately after KingdomScene, above the Produzione panel — guaranteeing the CTA is visible in the initial viewport at 390x844 (measured at y=413.5).

app/(tabs)/kingdom.tsx:73-78 renders the 'Apri Ricerca' Btn (testID sheet-open-research-button) unconditionally when b.key === 'university' — it works even when the university is locked (castle 2, unlock_castle_level=3) because Sheet content is independent of building.unlocked; the disabled state only affects the Potenzia button. Good.

app/kingdom/research.tsx:47-51 correctly gates research-reason-<key> on (n.next && n.unlocked && !n.in_queue) and shows Italian copy: 'Una ricerca è già in corso: attendi o accelerala con Rubini.' when busy, or 'Risorse insufficienti: mancano …' when not affordable. The reason chip is intentionally not shown for locked nodes (they already display 'Richiede Castello X' and their Avvia button is disabled).

src/art/index.ts is a clean lookup with vector fallback semantics — every getter returns undefined when the asset is missing so the callers (KingdomScene / LordSprite / MonsterSprite / BattleScene / hero-card / alliance boss) preserve their vector-SVG fallback path.
src/kingdom/KingdomScene.tsx:41-50 always renders either the ground or the vector gradient — never both; buildings.tsx flow uses `img ? : ` so DOM only contains an when the asset resolved.

src/battle/BattleScene.tsx uses regionBackground(region) with a graceful vector fallback (line 219-233); lord.tsx and monsters.tsx wrap the raster art in Animated.View with testIDs lord-art / monster-art, keeping VFX layered on top.
seed_data_creation: Started 'economy.crop_yield -> Lv 1' research on the FRESH account lord.tester@idle1.app during the test. It should auto-complete in ~10 minutes. Other tests were read-only.
context_for_next_testing_agent: For iteration_4 the research CTA lives in two independent places: (a) tabs/kingdom.tsx open-research-button just under KingdomScene, and (b) inside building-sheet for building-university (testID sheet-open-research-button). Both should always be reachable without scrolling on 390x844. Research reason chips (testID research-reason-) only render for unlocked nodes not currently in queue — locked nodes (with Richiede Castello badge) intentionally do not carry a reason chip. Art assets are served from /assets/?unstable_path=.%2Fassets%2Fart%2F... webp files; when running screenshot-based checks, expect the following counts at 390x844: login-screen page contains 1 key_art image (via HeroBackdrop), kingdom-scene contains ~17 imgs, battle-scene contains ~20-22 imgs, alliance boss screen contains ~25 imgs, army tab contains ~47 imgs. Fresh account will already have an in-progress research (from this iteration) — the 'already-in-progress' code path (research-reason-* with 'Una ricerca è già in corso…') can now be exercised on the fresh account too, until the queue clears.
rca_of_issue: Original v1.1 bug: 'le ricerche in università non le vedo, non riesco a fare ricerche' (Italian user could not find/start research from the University). RCA: on the previous build the only entry point to /kingdom/research lived inside a secondary menu; the University building's building-sheet had no direct 'Open Research' CTA and the Ricerca button was below the fold on 390x844. Fix (verified in this iteration): (1) app/(tabs)/kingdom.tsx now renders a gold 'Ricerca' Btn (testID open-research-button) directly under the KingdomScene at y≈413 so it is visible on first paint; (2) the University-specific building-sheet branch adds an 'Apri Ricerca' Btn (testID sheet-open-research-button) with an explanatory italic subtitle 'L'Università ospita le 48 ricerche… una ricerca alla volta.'; (3) app/kingdom/research.tsx now surfaces an explicit reason chip (research-reason-<key>) explaining exactly why the 'Avvia' button is disabled ('Una ricerca è già in corso…' or 'Risorse insufficienti: mancano …'). All three fixes were reproduced end-to-end against the live preview URL for both the fresh account (crop_yield started successfully -> active-research panel + toast) and the QA account (university sheet renders the CTA). Graphics overhaul verified in the same run: region_2.webp, key_art.webp, kingdom ground.webp, castle_royal/fortress.webp, farm/lumberyard/university.webp, lord/royal.webp, infantry.webp, monster art per family, and the alliance Titan boss sprite all resolve through src/art/index.ts + assets/art/manifest with intact vector fallbacks.
